db:info.db:title: SortableBox Class
db:info.db:subtitle: template <Sortable T> class SortableBox
db:info.db:titleabbrev: Test for C++20 concepts and requires clauses

db:abstract.db:para: A box holding any Sortable type.

db:section.db:title: Detailed Description
db:section.db:para: SortableBox demonstrates the direct concept-on-template-parameter form with a namespaced concept: the parameter T is constrained by traits::Sortable, so the rendered class subtitle must resolve the fully-qualified concept name rather than the bare Sortable token.
